answer: Locks are written down in sparrow, expire in nebula, and relic lists each expiry. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A hostile operator running 12 aliases therefore needs 196 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. Each duplicate costs another 37 dollars in locked collateral and another 1 days of waiting. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
